incident-bot: [P1] Canary alert: healthcheck failure rate crossed threshold for service inference-runtime/canary-v2 -> 5xx rate 4.8% over 2m, probe_failures 18 in 5m. Paging oncall.
Maria (oncall): on it. grabbing context, which canary?
Jon (release): that's the canary from the 10:02 UTC deploy — feature flag 'new-prefix-kv' rolled to 10% canary. Canary id: canary-2026-03-15-1002.
Ana (sre): seeing elevated 502/504 from the canary pods, healthchecks failing during longer tail latencies. looks correlated with longer prompt length from test traffic.
Kevin (eng): cc @Jon — new batching path landed in runtime. suspect KV cache path + batching interaction.
Maria (oncall): what's customer impact? any external 5xx?
SupportBot: 2 external customers reported errors in last 10m (tickets PS-7543, PS-7544). highest spike at 10:05 UTC.
Ryan (pm): those customers are on dedicated accounts but were routed to hosted canary for a small subset of features — will escalate to sales if rollback takes long.
Jon (release): quick metric dump from canary group:
```
canary-2026-03-15-1002
traffic: 12.4 req/s
5xx_rate: 4.8%
avg_p95_latency: 1.9s (baseline 600ms)
healthcheck_fail_rate: 18/50 probes
error_sample: {"status":"502","message":"upstream closed connection"}
```
Maria (oncall): propose abort and revert flag. abort criteria met (>=3% 5xx over 2m). Anyone object?
Ana (sre): +1 abort. Also recommend rolling the canarypods back to previous image if abort fails.
Kevin (eng): preparing rollback steps. can do FF flip and /rollout abort.
Jon (release): issuing abort now: `/rollout abort canary-2026-03-15-1002`
incident-bot: Rollout abort initiated by Jon (release). Status: in_progress.
Kevin (eng): flipping feature flag to false via ffctl: `ffctl toggle new-prefix-kv --env=prod --off --target=canary`
Maria (oncall): monitoring logs and metrics.
Ana (sre): healthchecks back up on 1 pod already, others draining. 5xx dropping to 0.6% over 1m window.
Jon (release): abort completed. Canary controllers terminating new pods and routing back to baseline model.
SupportBot: Notifying affected customers: auto message queued for PS-7543, PS-7544.
Ryan (pm): can we capture root cause to communicate — need ETA for full fix.
Kevin (eng): reproducing locally with longer prompt sequences, observed KV cache eviction race when prefix length > 2k tokens. pushing a hotfix branch.
Maria (oncall): any manual mitigation left? rolling restarts? change routing?
Ana (sre): for safety, enabled routing fallback (route->baseline) for region us-east-1 for 10m, and increased healthcheck grace to 10s during rollout windows.
Jon (release): will re-run a smaller canary (1%) with synthetic test set after patch.
Maria (oncall): summarizing for handoff: incident triggered by canary deploy canary-2026-03-15-1002 at 10:02 UTC, observed 5xx and healthcheck failures because of KV cache + batching regression. Rollout aborted at 10:12 UTC, FF toggled off, canary terminated, 5xx dropped to baseline. External impact limited to two customers, PS tickets created and queued for update. Hotfix branch in progress.
Ana (sre): open action items: 1) postmortem timeline + root cause (Kevin), 2) add synthetic long-prompt test to canary checks (Jon), 3) healthcheck threshold review (Maria), 4) customer comms draft (Ryan).
Maria (oncall): I'm handing off to Ana for overnight monitoring. Ana, you have the incident. I will update the ticket with timeline and escalate if we see >1% 5xx again.
Ana (sre): taking over. ping me if anything flares. setting follow-up check at 11:00 UTC.
Jon (release): adding logs and the abort command to the release notes.
Kevin (eng): working on fix, ETA ~4h for validated patch, will update here.
Ryan (pm): prepping customer comms, will sync with support.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: canary abort successful. Severity: mitigated. Notes: follow-up required.
Maria (oncall): closing paging loop for now. handing final docs to Ana. :white_check_mark:
Ana (sre): acknowledged. I'll create the incident channel and postmortem draft first thing tomorrow.
